heading: Drivers hope to quickly and efficiently complete their daily delivery tasks.
eyebrow: 💬 Diving deeper into details, we try to identify the needs of the delivery drivers.

blocks.html: We interviewed 8 delivery drivers (6 experienced drivers, 2 new drivers) to learn more about their daily delivery routines, identify the challenges and needs they face during the delivery process.
🤳🏻 Manually tab package ID one by one, which is very inefficient.
🗒 Unclear about which packages need to be delivered today.
🧭 Unaware of the most efficient delivery route.
📊 Have no knowledge of their KPIs.
